title: 12. Interview: Complete System Design Roadmap to Crack Top Product-Based Companies
summary: Interview Q&A for Complete System Design Roadmap to Crack Top Product-Based Companies.
objectives: Answer the Complete System Design Roadmap to Crack Top Product-Based Companies interview questions out loud
Lead with the concept, then a small example, then a tradeoff

sections.title: Interview Approach (RADIO Framework)
sections.body:
### R - Requirements
- Functional requirements
- Non-functional requirements (scale, performance, availability)
- Constraints and assumptions

### A - Architecture
- High-level design
- Component identification
- Communication patterns

### D - Data
- Data models
- Database choice
- Data flow

### I - Interface
- APIs design
- Communication protocols
- Client-server interaction

### O - Optimize
- Bottleneck identification
- Trade-offs discussion
- Scalability improvements

sections.title: Interview Checklist
sections.body:
Before each system design interview:
- [ ] Review common patterns (caching, sharding, load balancing)
- [ ] Practice drawing clean diagrams
- [ ] Review numbers and estimates
- [ ] Prepare questions to ask interviewer
- [ ] Review company's tech stack and architecture
- [ ] Practice one similar system design problem
- [ ] Get good sleep!
